## What changes for people using TYKERF

<!-- One topic per pull request. Say what someone using the editor, Kaity, the MCP server or the CLI will notice. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased* (start the section if it isn't there)
- [ ] The guides are updated if this changes what people see or how the code is extended, and `npm run docs:nav` was run after adding or renaming a page
- [ ] `docs/slicing-notation.md` is updated if the grammar, a move or a reference form changed
- [ ] For editor changes, a screenshot or a short recording below
